name: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

angles.text: As a mage, you know that notes from prominent figures like Archmage Theocritus help safeguard historical magical works in Ironforge's archives.
As an Alliance member, you help enrich Ironforge's great repository of knowledge for Alliance scholars.

faq.answer: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal is a scholarly record of his research. You bring it to the Ironforge Library to preserve arcane knowledge and enrich its archives.
faq.q: What is Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal?

faq.answer: Archmage Theocritus is an esteemed human mage stationed at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. He studies ancient magical disturbances and artifacts.

aliases: where do i turn in theocritus journal
faq.answer: You bring the journal to the archivists at the Library in Ironforge. They collect rare documents and magical manuscripts.
The Ironforge Library's scholars want to preserve arcane knowledge and study rare works by master spellcasters. These works expand their historical records.
faq.q: Why does the library want this journal?

aliases: are there other books for library
faq.answer: Yes. The curators encourage you to seek more magical works and historical texts for their archives.
faq.q: Can more magical works be delivered to the library?

faq.answer: The journal holds notes and observations from Archmage Theocritus' extensive investigations into magical phenomena and arcane lore.
faq.q: What kind of research is contained in the journal?

sections.body:
Archmage Theocritus is an esteemed spellcaster known throughout the Alliance. He is stationed at the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest, where he has studied alone for years. His investigations range from curious artifacts and ley line anomalies to nearby magical threats.

He records his findings in detailed journals. This volume offers a rare chance to study the personal observations of a senior Kirin Tor archmage.
sections.title: A Master's Field Notes

sections.body: The Explorers' League and the caretakers of the Ironforge Library maintain one of the continent's greatest archives. You bring Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal to them, helping preserve and catalog its arcane insights beside the historic volumes of Khaz Modan. The librarians welcome further magical discoveries that can broaden their shared wisdom.
sections.title: Expanding the Ironforge Archives

summary: At the Tower of Azora, Archmage Theocritus keeps a journal of his investigations. Now you carry its magical insights to the scholars of the Ironforge Library, where they can join the dwarven archive.
